notes.title: Space Moth: Lunar Edition is coming Soon!
STAR HUNTER DX GETS A NEW LOW PRICE!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40115986/4e5e463d7232a92f058cfe9a0aec8e4bc543d459.jpg[/img]

To mark the imminent release of 1CC Games' next super-shmup, [i]Space Moth: Lunar Edition[/i], we've reduced the price - permanently! - of the critically acclaimed [i]Star Hunter DX[/i]. Jump in!

notes.title: Star Hunter DX Demo Playthrough and Q&A Livestream with the Devs!
notes.content:
Betrayed by her cut-throat crew, Luna Starr - former Space Pirate Captain turned bounty hunter - has a score to settle. Travel to five exotic planets to track down your mutinous mates, facing them in exhilarating bullet hell dogfights to the death!

Join Dan and James from Star Hunter DX's development team, 1CC Games, and Jez from its publisher, Chorus Worldwide, as they play through the demo and answer your questions!

notes.title: Star Hunter DX demo out now!
notes.content: Celebrating Steam Next Fest, get a taster of 1CC Games' retro-infused shmup, Star Hunter DX, before it launches this August.
